editorial:
Imagine taking your messiest friend to a lonely cabin in the middle of nowhere just to force them to get clean. That is exactly how this story starts. You get two guys who are totally on different pages: one is trying to be the hero, and the other is just trying to find his next fix. At first, it feels like a simple drama about friendship and addiction, but things get weird fast. You start to notice that the environment around them is acting strange, and it feels like someone, or something, is watching them and playing a game with their lives.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing. The acting feels real, and the way the mystery builds up is great. It does start a bit slow, but once the twists hit, you will be glued to your screen. If you love stories that make you question what is real, you should definitely check this out. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You find out that a mysterious entity is filming the men and manipulating their reality. The entity wants a satisfying ending to their story, so it forces them into a scary situation. In the final scenes, the characters realize they are just actors in a movie they cannot control. The entity eventually deletes them or resets the scene because it was not happy with how the story ended, leaving you with a chilling twist.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and weird twists.
